say:1:1510949001:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?
say:1:1510949001:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?
say:1:1510949001:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?

choice_prompt:2:1510949001.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?
choice_prompt:2:1510949001.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?
choice_prompt:2:1510949001.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You're going to face the Hunting Goddess, aren't you?

say:3:1510949002:1.text: ... Just like with the God of Harvest.
say:3:1510949002:1.male: ... Just like with the God of Harvest.
say:3:1510949002:1.female: ... Just like with the God of Harvest.

say:6:1510949006:1.text: Without you, I wouldn't be here.
say:6:1510949006:1.male: Without you, I wouldn't be here.
say:6:1510949006:1.female: Without you, I wouldn't be here.

say:7:1510949007:1.text: Modra always said the goddess would bless the Wildborn—that our spears would strike true, our hunts would thrive.
say:7:1510949007:1.source_cn: 蒙多说，神明会护佑雅库伯尔，让雅库伯尔的矛永远锋利，猎...
say:7:1510949007:1.male: Modra always said the goddess would bless the Wildborn—that our spears would strike true, our hunts would thrive.
say:7:1510949007:1.female: Modra always said the goddess would bless the Wildborn—that our spears would strike true, our hunts would thrive.

say:8:1510949008:1.text: I believed that. I found pride in devoting myself to the divine.
say:8:1510949008:1.source_cn: 所以，我信仰神。以献身于神为荣。神喜悦，我就喜悦。
say:8:1510949008:1.male: I believed that. I found pride in devoting myself to the divine.
say:8:1510949008:1.female: I believed that. I found pride in devoting myself to the divine.

say:9:1510949009:1.text: But Azora... she betrayed the Wildborn. Abandoned her followers. She let her beasts feed on our dead!
say:9:1510949009:1.source_cn: 但奥法迦……她背叛了雅库伯尔，抛弃了她的信徒，甚至让兽...
say:9:1510949009:1.male: But Azora... she betrayed the Wildborn. Abandoned her followers. She let her beasts feed on our dead!
say:9:1510949009:1.female: But Azora... she betrayed the Wildborn. Abandoned her followers. She let her beasts feed on our dead!

say:10:1510949010:1.text: Just like the God of Harvest, who turned on his own.
say:10:1510949010:1.source_cn: 就像堕落的丰饶神，会毁灭自己的信徒和子民。
say:10:1510949010:1.male: Just like the God of Harvest, who turned on his own.
say:10:1510949010:1.female: Just like the God of Harvest, who turned on his own.

say:11:1510949011:1.text: That's not the kind of deity we need.
say:11:1510949011:1.source_cn: 那不是雅库伯尔需要的神。
say:11:1510949011:1.male: That's not the kind of deity we need.
say:11:1510949011:1.female: That's not the kind of deity we need.

choice_prompt:12:1510949011.text: That's not the kind of deity we need.
choice_prompt:12:1510949011.source_cn: 那不是雅库伯尔需要的神。
choice_prompt:12:1510949011.male: That's not the kind of deity we need.
choice_prompt:12:1510949011.female: That's not the kind of deity we need.

say:13:1510949012:1.text: You protected me. You taught me. You even stooped to care for me, wiping my face...
say:13:1510949012:1.source_cn: 是您保护我、教导我。您甚至愿意屈尊照顾我，为我擦脸……
say:13:1510949012:1.male: You protected me. You taught me. You even stooped to care for me, wiping my face...
say:13:1510949012:1.female: You protected me. You taught me. You even stooped to care for me, wiping my face...

say:14:1510949013:1.text: And now, I want to protect you.
say:14:1510949013:1.male: And now, I want to protect you.
say:14:1510949013:1.female: And now, I want to protect you.

say:16:1510949015:1.text: Let me fight by your side.
say:16:1510949015:1.male: Let me fight by your side.
say:16:1510949015:1.female: Let me fight by your side.

choice_prompt:17:1510949015.text: Let me fight by your side.
choice_prompt:17:1510949015.male: Let me fight by your side.
choice_prompt:17:1510949015.female: Let me fight by your side.

say:18:1510949016:1.text: You once told me to live for myself.
say:18:1510949016:1.male: You once told me to live for myself.
say:18:1510949016:1.female: You once told me to live for myself.

say:19:1510949017:1.text: Even you can't change my decision.
say:19:1510949017:1.source_cn: 即便是您，也无法改变我的决定。
say:19:1510949017:1.male: Even you can't change my decision.
say:19:1510949017:1.female: Even you can't change my decision.

choice_prompt:20:1510949017.text: Even you can't change my decision.
choice_prompt:20:1510949017.source_cn: 即便是您，也无法改变我的决定。
choice_prompt:20:1510949017.male: Even you can't change my decision.
choice_prompt:20:1510949017.female: Even you can't change my decision.

say:21:1510949018:1.text: I'll protect you too, just as you taught me.
say:21:1510949018:1.source_cn: 我也会保护您，用您教我的方式。
say:21:1510949018:1.male: I'll protect you too, just as you taught me.
say:21:1510949018:1.female: I'll protect you too, just as you taught me.

say:22:1510949019:1.text: Keep your wits sharp, and value your life.
say:22:1510949019:1.source_cn: 动用头脑，并且，珍惜自己的生命。
say:22:1510949019:1.male: Keep your wits sharp, and value your life.
say:22:1510949019:1.female: Keep your wits sharp, and value your life.

choice:20:0:1.text: Your safety is important to me...
choice:20:0:1.male: Your safety is important to me...
choice:20:0:1.female: Your safety is important to me...

choice:20:1:2.text: I'll do everything I can to keep you safe.
choice:20:1:2.male: I'll do everything I can to keep you safe.
choice:20:1:2.female: I'll do everything I can to keep you safe.

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 我们要去的地方很危险

choice:17:1:2.text: What if I asked you to stay behind?
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 如果我说，希望你留下来呢？
choice:17:1:2.male: What if I asked you to stay behind?
choice:17:1:2.female: What if I asked you to stay behind?

choice:12:0:1.text: You don't need to rush this decision.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 你不用这么快做出决定
choice:12:0:1.male: You don't need to rush this decision.
choice:12:0:1.female: You don't need to rush this decision.

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 但狩猎神是你信仰的神

choice:5:2:3.text: She's a goddess. You could die out there.
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 奥法迦是真正的神，你可能会死
choice:5:2:3.male: She's a goddess. You could die out there.
choice:5:2:3.female: She's a goddess. You could die out there.

choice:2:0:1.text: I'm sorry. We have to stop her.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我们必须清除堕神
choice:2:0:1.male: I'm sorry. We have to stop her.
choice:2:0:1.female: I'm sorry. We have to stop her.

say:25:1510949003:1.text: No... but Merlin said defeating her is the only way to send you back.
say:25:1510949003:1.source_cn: 没有……但是梅林说过，只有打败堕神，才能帮您返回未来……
say:25:1510949003:1.male: No... but Merlin said defeating her is the only way to send you back.
say:25:1510949003:1.female: No... but Merlin said defeating her is the only way to send you back.

choice:2:2:3.text: Yes. We know where she is now.
choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 没错，已经知道她去了哪里
choice:2:2:3.male: Yes. We know where she is now.
choice:2:2:3.female: Yes. We know where she is now.
